summary: Frontend-only regression + feature tests for (1) PublicStatus auto-refresh bug fix and (2) Customer Rating & Review feature (form, thank-you card, admin /reviews page, RBAC). All 7 requested scenarios PASS on the preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: PublicStatus.jsx polls localStorage every 4s per open public-status tab; acceptable for mock, but on real backend switch to a debounced fetch or SSE/websocket to avoid unnecessary reads.
Reviews.jsx sorts by rated_at without null guard — future items lacking rated_at (should never happen via addRating) would sort as Invalid Date. Consider defensive `new Date(x.rated_at || 0)`.

repairsApi.addRating masks its 'already rated' guard behind an exception; the UI relies solely on the presence of repair.rating to hide the form. Aligned, but keep both in sync if new code paths mutate rating.
Rating textarea maxLength=500 matches spec; consider trimming whitespace-only input server-side when PHP endpoint is wired.
seed_data_creation: In localStorage of the test browser: submitted rating (4 stars, review 'Servis cepat dan ramah - test.') on KK-2501-001. KK-2501-006 was temporarily flipped to in_progress by admin during test 1 then restored to 'pending' via localStorage patch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified: opening /status/KK-2501-006 in tab A, then logging in as admin in tab B and clicking 'In Progress' on repair r6 caused the public status chip to auto-update to IN PROGRESS within ~5s without manual reload (screenshot captured). Manual refresh button (btn-refresh-status) also works. Rating flow: star-4 -> label 'Baik'; submit -> thank-you card with 4 filled stars + quote; reload keeps thank-you (persisted). /reviews admin page shows avg 4.0, count 1, positive 100%; filter-star-4 and search 'rina' both narrow to the seeded review. RBAC: technician has NO nav-reviews and /reviews redirects to /dashboard; cashier has nav-reviews and page renders (sidebar visibility had a brief render delay but Playwright auto-wait handled it).
